sessionHistory.note: Integrated/verified PAN-2402 cost-limit attribution fix (already present from predecessor agent's salvage work on rescue/pan-2402-primary-salvage). Anomalies addressed: (1) three pre-existing unit-test failures in close-issue/workflows tests caused by commit 2518d740db adding a 'gh issue view --json labels' query that the mocks returned empty — fixed the mocks to return the expected workflow labels; (2) file-size guard required updating scripts/file-size-baseline.txt from 2051 to 2054 lines for the audited service.ts growth from the attribution fix. Delivered: cost warnings now use explicit '(unattributed)' bucket instead of 'undefined'; per-agent/per-issue accumulators are scoped to today's spend via getAgentDailyCostSync() and getDailyTrends({ days: 1, issueId }); regression tests cover both bugs. Note: rescue/pan-2402-primary-salvage branch remains on remote and should be cleaned up by operator.
